input.body:
Dear Tenant,

Thank you for reporting that your bedroom window is not closing properly because one of the hinges is rusted. We have logged this (ref TKT-6175C6) and asked your landlord whether they want us to send a contractor.

So we can arrange the right repair as quickly as possible, please reply with:
1. Can you still shut the window fully and lock it? Or is it stuck open, or would it let someone get in?
2. Which floor is the flat on?
3. Is rain or a draught coming in?
4. If you can, a photo of the rusted hinge and the window when it is closed.

If the window cannot be shut or locked, or it is letting rain in, please tell us straight away. We will then treat it as an emergency and send someone to make it safe.

Until then, please do not force the window, as this could damage the hinge more. We will let you know who is coming once a contractor is arranged. If you have any pets, please tell us so we can pass this on to the contractor.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings
